name: Kirkland Signature Organic Frozen Mango Chunks (FODMAP Warning)
whyItWorks: Mango contains excess free fructose over glucose. In patients with IBD or compromised brush-border absorption, unabsorbed fructose rapidly ferments in the colon, producing gas, bloating, and osmotic diarrhea.
prepOrOrderInstructions: High Fructose Warning: Limit to a few small chunks in smoothies during stable remission. Avoid during active diarrhea.
